offer_misses_branch.source:
mod Main do
  needs IO
  needs Session.Live

  @[endpoints]
  protocol Order do
    role Stock needs IO.Mut
    role Ledger needs IO.Console
    loop do
      want: Shop -> Stock : Int
      choose by Stock:
        have -> Stock -> Shop : String
                book: Stock -> Ledger : Int
                booked: Ledger -> Shop : String
        out  -> Stock -> Shop : String
                skip: Stock -> Ledger : Int
                stop
      end
    end
  end

  -- Shop handles the `have` answer and has nothing for `out`.
  pfn shop(s : Cap(Session.Live), st : Order_Shop.Entry) : Order_Shop.Yield do
    let st1 = Order_Shop.send_Want(s, st, 1)
    Order_Shop.offer_have_out(s, st1,
      fn (_v, st2) -> Order_Shop.recv_Booked(s, st2, fn (_b, st3) -> shop(s, st3)))
  end

  fn main(_c : Cap(IO)) do () end
end

  Order_Stock.recv_Want(s, st, fn (n, st1) ->
    stock(s, _m, Order_Stock.send_Book(s, st1, n)))
end

mod Main do
  needs IO
  needs Session.Live

  @[endpoints]
  protocol Order do
    role Stock needs IO.Mut
    role Ledger needs IO.Console

      want: Shop -> Stock : Int
      choose by Stock:
        have -> Stock -> Shop : String
                book: Stock -> Ledger : Int
                booked: Ledger -> Shop : String
        out  -> Stock -> Shop : String
                skip: Stock -> Ledger : Int

      end
    end

  -- Stock tells Ledger to book before it has chosen `have` or `out`.
